On January 15, Jiemian News visited a Xibei restaurant amid reports of widespread closures. During dinner hours, foot traffic was steady, though there was no wait for tables. Staff said they had not received any notice about a potential shutdown.
Xibei founder Jia Guolong has confirmed plans to close 102 locations, with the process expected to be completed gradually in the first quarter.
He said all affected employees would be fully paid, with no wages withheld.
Public data shows the closures account for nearly 30% of Xibei’s total stores and could impact around 4,000 employees.
